criteria_verification.notes: PlanningGateRepository and PlanningStateMachine implement all required protocol methods. Tests test_repository_satisfies_gate_repository_protocol and test_state_machine_satisfies_protocol verify structural compliance via hasattr checks for all required methods including record_decision, record_paused_build, list_paused_builds, and state transitions.

record_paused_build stores pending_approval_request_id on planning_runs row and stamps paused_at timestamp (RT-04 wall-clock anchor). Gate decisions write planning_run_events rows with gate_mode and details_json metadata. Tests test_record_paused_build_stores_request_id_and_stamps_paused_at and test_gate_decisions_write_events_with_metadata verify both persistence mechanisms.

list_paused_builds() queries planning_runs for PAUSED state, extracts stage_label/attempt_count via parse_request_id, rehydrates GateDecision from event details_json, and constructs PausedBuildSnapshot with correlation_id, expected_approver, pending request id, and paused_at/escalated_at fields. Test test_list_paused_builds_reconstructs_snapshots verifies complete snapshot reconstruction sufficient for TASK-MP-009 rearm sweep.

State-changing methods delegate to store.transition() which returns TransitionRefused sentinel on CAS failure. Methods check terminal states before transitions and log warnings instead of raising exceptions. Tests test_transition_to_paused_delegates_to_store and test_stale_transitions_do_not_raise verify both delegation and graceful refusal handling.

No files under src/forge/gating/ were modified. Implementation imports derive_request_id and parse_request_id from gating module but does not modify any gating module code. Gate adapters implemented as parallel adapter in src/forge/planning/ without touching src/forge/gating/ behaviour.

All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks. Evidence shows ruff check --fix ran successfully with all linting errors resolved (removed unused imports). Final lint check shows zero remaining errors.

rationale: All 6 acceptance criteria verified with passing tests. Independent test verification (47 tests, 0 failures) confirms protocol satisfaction, data persistence, snapshot reconstruction, CAS transition handling, zero gating module modifications, and lint compliance. Honesty discrepancies are worktree path reporting confusion (honesty_score: 1.0, severity: should_fix), not fabrications. All quality gates passed.
